description: This file defines interface functions and macros for handling universal trigger decoders in an engine management system, including configuring trigger shapes and adding trigger events based on tooth detection.

methods.name: addSkippedToothTriggerEvents
methods.description: Adds trigger events for skipped teeth on a trigger wheel, considering wheel position, tooth geometry, and filter parameters.

methods.name: initializeSkippedToothTriggerShapeExt
methods.description: Initializes a trigger shape with skipped teeth settings based on total teeth count, skipped teeth, and operation mode.

methods.name: configureOnePlus60_2
methods.description: Configures a trigger shape with a specific setup pattern, likely one plus 60 teeth, for a given operation mode.

methods.name: configure3_1_cam
methods.description: Configures a trigger shape tailored for a 3-1 cam trigger pattern.

methods.name: configureOnePlusOne
methods.description: Sets up a trigger shape with a one plus one tooth pattern.
